definition: A progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized clinically by parkinsonism and other motor and non-motor features.
clinical_description: Typical features include bradykinesia with rest tremor and/or rigidity, together with a range of non-motor manifestations.

definition: An immune-mediated disease of the central nervous system with inflammatory and neurodegenerative components.
clinical_description: Symptoms vary with lesion location and disease course and may include visual, sensory, motor, coordination and cognitive problems.
